DR Congo Faces Health Worker Shortage Amid Ebola Surge

The Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing a growing shortage of health workers as Ebola cases surge by 73%, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). The outbreak is described as 'out-of-control' by Sky News. The situation is exacerbated by the limited number of available health professionals.
